text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali tells National Electricity Office (ONE) there will be no increase of electricity bills this year.
- Morocco and France sign initial accord to set up free trade zone in the northern city of Nador.
- Taxi drivers pursue 9th day strike after authorities refuse to meet demands for lower insurance costs.
- British tycoon Richard Branson's round the world trip aborts after his balloon lands in Algeria.
- Anti-locusts centre says air and land squads are on stand-by in the southern areas but there is no danger of invasion.
- Crackdown on smuggling had positive impact on taxation with a 15 percent increase of receipts from VAT on imports and a 30 percent rise in receipts of local VAT during second half of 1996.
